topic: Eigenvectors, Eigenvalues, and Eigenbasis: The Geometry of Linear Transformations

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The 'Stretch' Concept
lecture_lines: Most vectors rotate away from their span.
Some vectors stay on their original span.
These special vectors only scale in length.
We call these vectors our eigenvectors.
animations: Display a square object on screen, color #FFFFFF.
Animate the square stretching horizontally, color #FF4500.
Show the square stretching vertically, color #00CED1.

sections.title: Defining Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
lecture_lines: Equation Av equals lambda v defines them.
Eigenvector v keeps its direction constant.
Eigenvalue lambda scales the vector magnitude.
animations: Show matrix A acting on vector v, color #FFFFFF.
Label vector v as eigenvector and Av as eigenvalue, color #32CD32.

sections.title: Visualizing Eigenbasis
lecture_lines: Eigenbasis acts as a custom coordinate system.
Standard basis vectors change directions unpredictably.
Eigenbasis makes matrix math simple diagonal.
Transformations look like simple scaling now.
Rotating the camera reveals this structure.
animations: Plot the eigenvectors of a matrix, color #FF6347.
Animate the grid transforming along these vectors, color #87CEEB.
Highlight the steady grid lines as eigenbasis, color #FFFF00.
Show matrix application as scaling along eigenbasis, color #BA55D3.
Emphasize the independence of these basis vectors, color #FFA500.

sections.title: Real-World Application: The 'Search Engine' Perspective
lecture_lines: Eigenvectors simplify massive data sets effectively.
Principal eigenvalues highlight major data trends.
PageRank ranks influence using principal eigenvectors.
animations: Show a web graph with nodes, color #FFFFFF.
Animate the importance flow across nodes, color #00FF00.
Identify the primary eigenvalue/eigenvector as page rank, color #FF00FF.

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
lecture_lines: Matrices are functions changing vector spaces.
Eigenvectors are invariant axes of transformation.
Eigenvalues measure transformation intensity along axes.
animations: Review the stretching concept visually, color #FF4500.
